mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs fall for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous negative GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly) and CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% signals stagflationary conditions where policy responses weaken equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth is negative and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% and increasing at >0.2% per month force higher real interest rates that reduce equity discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0% and is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200 thousand units signal contraction in the residential construction sector, indicating weakening consumer demand and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and weak retail sales growth (RSAFS growth < 0.5%) signals broad-based supply-demand mismatch that reduces corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is below 105.0 and RSAFS growth is less than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 250.0) forces central banks to prioritize inflation control over growth, increasing real interest rates and equity discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0.
